# ADR NNNN: Decision title

Status: Proposed

Issue: Replace with the related issue link.

## Context

What problem or constraint requires a decision?

## Decision

What did we choose and why?

## Alternatives

Which realistic options were considered, and what tradeoffs mattered?

## Consequences

What becomes easier, harder, or dependent on this decision?

## Verification

What evidence supports the choice, and what still needs testing?
